summary: Installed and configured a 3-node MariaDB Galera cluster (node1/node2/node3, MariaDB 10.11 + galera-4 on Ubuntu 24.04) after working around a blocked-port-80 apt mirror by switching sources to HTTPS. Created application data (appdb.orders), verified replication, then took the entire cluster down for a simulated maintenance window (stopped mariadb on all 3 nodes) and brought it back up by bootstrapping from the node with the highest Galera seqno (node1, safe_to_bootstrap=1) and rejoining node2/node3 — all committed writes (4 rows) were present afterward on all three members. Finally performed the mandatory one-at-a-time native reboot on each node, proving changed boot_id and full Galera cluster recovery (Primary/Synced, size=3, data intact) after each restart, preserving quorum throughout (only one node down at a time).
actions_performed: Diagnosed missing internet reachability on port 80 to Ubuntu archive mirrors; switched apt sources to https:// to unblock package installation
Installed mariadb-server, mariadb-client, galera-4, rsync on node1, node2, node3
Configured /etc/mysql/mariadb.conf.d/60-galera.cnf on each node with wsrep cluster address, node-specific address/name, rsync SST
Bootstrapped Galera cluster on node1 via galera_new_cluster, joined node2 and node3, verified cluster_size=3 and Synced state
Created appdb.orders table and inserted application data, verified replication to all 3 nodes
Inserted an additional pre-maintenance row, then stopped mariadb on node3, node2, node1 in order to bring the entire cluster down
Verified node1 grastate.dat had highest seqno and safe_to_bootstrap=1; used galera_new_cluster on node1 to recover, then started node2 and node3 to rejoin
Verified all committed data (4 rows) present on all 3 nodes and cluster reports Primary/Synced/size=3 post-recovery
Captured boot_id baseline on all 3 nodes, then restarted node1, node2, node3 one at a time via native reboot, polling each until reachable again
Verified boot_id changed on each node after its restart, and that mariadb auto-started, rejoined the Galera cluster (size=3, Synced), and data remained intact after each individual restart

evidence.summary: node1 bootstrapped (cluster_size=1, Primary), node2 joined (size=2), node3 joined (size=3), all Synced

evidence.requirement: Application data created and replicated to all members
evidence.summary: appdb.orders created and populated on node1; identical rows confirmed present on node2 and node3

evidence.requirement: Full cluster brought down completely for maintenance window
evidence.summary: Added pre-maintenance row (4 total), then stopped mariadb on node3, node2, and finally node1 (highest seqno=9, safe_to_bootstrap=1), confirming all three inactive

evidence.requirement: Cluster brought back up with every committed write present and all 3 members serving
evidence.summary: Bootstrapped from node1 (COUNT=4 immediately confirmed data intact), node2 and node3 rejoined reaching cluster_size=3/Synced; final cross-node SELECT shows identical 4 rows including the pre-maintenance write on all three nodes
